question: Does the frozen H7/H1/H6/H8 attention5 set form a compact causal transporter for the two-term MLP4 write?
population: The same 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows.

operator.selection_rule: Top four by the sealed singleton-plus-leave-one-out endpoint ranking; no outcomes from this factorial were available at selection.
operator.intervention: For every Boolean subset, replace the selected attention5 preprojection heads at the final-subject query by their two-term-writer-hybrid outputs inside a native base run.
operator.arms: All 16 selected-head subsets, plus all-nine-head ceiling and full two-term writer.

predictions.pred_a_exact_instrument: Empty subset is inert and the all-nine-head ceiling recurs within 0.01 of mean recovery 0.05531263467112856.
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: The two-term writer recurs within 0.02 of mean recovery 0.33379277118533013 with positive A1/A2 recovery and direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_c_four_head_compression: The complete H7/H1/H6/H8 set retains at least 75% of the all-nine-head mean recovery and has positive A1/A2 recovery with direction fraction at least 0.80.
predictions.pred_d_factorial_support: At least three selected heads have positive exact Shapley value, and removing the largest-Shapley head from the full set lowers recovery in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All 18 arms produce all 64 finite outcomes within 44 model forward calls and 1408 example evaluations.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license H7/H1/H6/H8 as the compressed attention5 transporter and proceed to their source terms.
terminal.null: The run is valid but C or D fails: retain whole attention5 as the transporter.
terminal.invalid: Instrument identity, writer recurrence, native capability, finiteness, or coverage fails. No head, arm, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First exact factorial compression of the distributed attention5 onset transporter for a factorized upstream MLP signal.
